task_spec: Collection dedupe for Traktor NML: find duplicate collection ENTRYs in four tiers, merge losers' metadata into a chosen survivor, redirect every track reference to it, and write a new NML, via a `dedupe` CLI command and a `/dedupe` GUI section

scope: traktor_nml/dedupe.py (new), traktor_nml/commands/dedupe_cmd.py (new), traktor_nml/gui/dedupe_model.py + dedupe_steps.py (new), traktor_nml/gui/app.py, traktor_nml/gui/navigation.py, traktor_nml/README.md decision log, spike/dedupe/, tests/ and tests/fixtures/dedupe/
out-of-scope: deleting/moving/renaming audio files; editing the input NML in place; keyboard or accessibility work; widening splice._TRACKED_ATTRS or changing splice behaviour
constraints: MUST: follow docs/plans/2026-09-26-collection-dedupe/plan.md (reviewed twice; its reference inventory, merge data model, path policy, recovery sequence, decisions schema and test gates G0-G8 are fixed)
MUST: G0 - record DL entries in traktor_nml/README.md before M-002 code
MUST: M-001 spike (reference inventory + AUDIO_ID stability) before M-002; tier 3 only if promotion thresholds met
MUST: nicegui-free view models (DL-069); page code only in app.py
MUST: byte-span patching (spans/textpatch), never reserialise; write via rewrite.write_bytes_atomically inside dedupe.write_validated_output
MUST: exit codes 0 / 2 (argparse usage and refusals) / 3 (post-write validation failed)
MUST: never write to an input path or the live collection.nml; any dangling reference or unknown reference shape refuses
MUST-NOT: use matching._fold for location equality; treat unprobed volumes as case-sensitive
entry_points: traktor_nml/playlists.py:find_playlist_nodes/node_primary_keys - existing playlist reference discovery (PLAYLIST nodes only)
traktor_nml/model.py:EntryRecord - identity fields only; MergeFields sits beside it
traktor_nml/gui/navigation.py:SECTIONS, conflict_model.py, answer_detail.py, reconstruct_steps.py - GUI patterns to follow
rejected_alternatives: Reusing write_nml_safely - drives tree mutation/reserialisation and prints its own stats
Summing PLAYCOUNT - double-counts shared listening history; max chosen (still an open question for M-001)
Exit code 1 for usage errors - conflicts with argparse's 2 used repo-wide
Widening EntryRecord / _TRACKED_ATTRS for merge fields - would change splice
Deleting audio files - tool only edits collection files
current_understanding: NML: COLLECTION/ENTRY keyed by LOCATION (VOLUME, VOLUMEID, DIR, FILE); playlists reference by PRIMARYKEY KEY path string; deleting an ENTRY without redirecting orphans references
Existing commands preview before writing, refuse to overwrite inputs, report ambiguity via stats and CSV
GUI is nicegui; three sections today (reconstruct /, reconnect, build-playlist)
assumptions: AUDIO_ID stable across copies/re-analysis (L - measured by M-001)
History/_LOOPS/_RECORDINGS use the PRIMARYKEY shape (M - confirmed by M-001)
Real library, re-analysed copy and copy/format-converted sample are available for M-001 (M - needs confirmation)
Appending raw CUE_V2 spans needs no ordering/count fix-up (M - check in M-001)
invisible_knowledge: Failure mode must always be a missed duplicate, never a wrong merge: unprobed volumes case-sensitive, unmapped volumes unknown not dead
Generic dangling-key scan is the backstop that makes unknown reference shapes refuse rather than orphan
Decisions file keyed by sorted member primary keys; stale groups dropped, never refused
write_validated_output is the single write path so CLI and GUI cannot skip post-write validation
reference_docs: docs/plans/2026-09-26-collection-dedupe/plan.md - the reviewed design this plan implements
